Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this one-sided affair. Australia go 1-0 up but Sri Lanka will look to draw things up in the 2nd T20I which is on Wednesday, 8th June at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up as well. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Aaron Finch, the skipper of Australia says that they have had a really similar group for a while, everyone understands their role, and it's only about giving them confidence. Mentions that Josh Hazlewood bowled at a consistent length, Sri Lanka played very well in the powerplay but they were able to control the middle overs. Adds that he feels nice to get some runs and put on a partnership with David Warner. Concludes by saying that it was a good performance overall.

The skipper of Sri Lanka, Dasun Shanaka says that it is a day that everything went wrong for them. Mentions that they had a serious talk regarding their batting, they spoke about the openers providing them with a start, however, the batters will have to come up with a plan. Further adds that it's the first game of the series and hoping they will have better days.

Josh Hazlewood is the Player of the Match for his excellent figures of (4-0-16-4) - He says it was not the ideal conditions to bowl as it was hot and sweaty, but they bowled well as a unit and the results showed. Mentions that the new ball flew off the bat in the beginning but they pulled things back and back of a length did work in their favour. Adds that he has been working hard on his T20 game, playing a lot of it.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

A dominant performance from Australia. Aaron Finch won the toss and since then it was all going his way. The first half of the first innings was dominated by the hosts but things started to turn around as once the top three fell, wickets started to fall like a pack of cards. It was the two frontline bowlers, Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood who ran through the batting lineup. The chase was like a walk in the park for the two great Aussie openers - David Warner and Aaron Finch. They brought their respective fifties and crossed the victory line with ease.

Sri Lanka will be really disappointed with how things panned out. From being 100 for 1 to nose-diving and bundling out at 128 is not a good sign for them. It was always going to be a hard job for the bowlers to defend a below-par score on a pitch that was a belter for batting. The Sri Lankan bowlers tried their best but they were always behind the 8-ball and ultimately failed to even open their wicket column.

Australia go 1-0 up in the three-match T20I series without hardly breaking a sweat. A commanding performance from the Aussies, the bowlers did the job earlier and it was superbly followed by the openers to win by 10 wickets. The win was inevitable for the visitors even when the rain stopped the play as they were very close to the finishing line.

SIX! Aaron Finch finishes things off in style! Another shorter ball, outside off. Aaron Finch stays in his crease, opens the face of the bat once again, and upper cuts it over third man all the way for a biggie. Australia win by 10 wickets!
FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter ball, wide of off. Aaron Finch hangs back, opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for a boundary. Australia are just one away now!
On a length, around middle and leg. David Warner tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Two in a row! Touch short now, on middle. Warner pulls it to deep backward sqaure leg. The fielder runs to his right and tries to flick it away but fails to do so. Another boundary. Just 6 needed now.
FOUR! On a length and on the hips. David Warner hangs back and helps it away to fine leg for a one-bounce four.
A length ball, on off. Warner taps it to covers. Finch wants a quick single but was sent back wisely by his partner.
Another single as this is eased down by Warner to long on. Just 14 needed now.
On middle, fuller and it is drilled down to long on for a single.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR FINCH! 17th half-century for him! Both the openers have been superb from the start! This is full and outside off. Finch opens the face of the bat and drives it over point for a boundary.
Wide! Thushara bangs a short one but again he errs in line, spills it down the leg side. Left alone for a wide.
Pitched up, on middle. Finch forces it to square leg where a bit of fumble allows a couple of runs.
Wide! A yorker-length delivery but was sliding down the leg side. Finch misses his flick and a wide is given.
Another single! This is full and on off. Warner hits it to deep cover for a run.
Full and slanting on the pads. Finch nudges it to deep square leg for a single.
Nuwan Thushara comes back to bowl.
Floats it full and outside off, it is driven to long off for a single.
A short ball, quicker and on the pads. Warner flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
We are ready to resume once again! The players are out in the middle. Maheesh Theekshana will continue.
UPDATE - 10:41 pm IST (5:11 pm GMT) - We have good news, folks! The covers are coming off and the play is all set to resume at 10:55 pm IST (5:25 pm GMT). No overs have been lost!
It is still raining in Colombo. If it continues to do so, Australia will be declared winners. Only if the play does not resume. The DLS par score is 65 for now, and the visitors are well ahead.

UPDATE  - 10.05 pm IST (4.35 pm GMT) - The rain has gotten heavier now and the covers are coming on! 28 runs needed in 50 balls. Australia are clearly well ahead in the game and on DLS as well. We wait for further updates. Stay tuned...
Wide! Short but way down the leg side. Left alone. Wide given.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Finch laps it to short fine leg for a single. 100 up for Australia. 29 needed off 50 balls.
Slightly short and on middle. Warner gets low and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. One more.
It has started to drizzle once again! The groundstaff are ready with the covers. But let's hope the rain stays away.
Around off, this is pushed to covers for a single.
Shorter and on middle, Warner turns it to deep square leg for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana (3-0-18-0) comes back into the attack.

DROPPED! Opportunity missed for Sri Lanka! This is full and on off. David Warner drives it on the up but hits it at a catching height to Pathum Nissanka at covers who tries to reverse-cup it but spills it out. A single.
Bangs a bouncer, on middle. Finch pulls it to deep square leg for one more.
On a length and on middle, at a slower side. Warner backs away and chops it to third man for a single.
Too full and on off. Finch makes room and steps down to ease it to long on for a single.
On middle, fuller, flicked through square leg for a single.

FOUR! FIFTY FOR WARNER! His 22nd half-century in T20Is! What a player! This is short but the line is down the leg side. Warner pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary. He raises his bat and soaks all the applause from his teammates.

Edged....and SAFE! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Aaron Finch looks to sweep this but the ball goes off the top edge towards fine leg. Nothing going right for Sri Lanka at the moment. Australia are 87 for 0 at the halfway mark.
Slower this time, fuller, around off. Aaron Finch drives it towards mid off.
Dushmantha Chameera continues with bowling the shorter ball, around middle. David Warner pushes it towards cover for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera drops it short again, around middle. Aaron Finch pulls it towards the fielder at long on. Single!
Back of a length, around middle. David Warner miscues his pull towards cover for a run.
Pitches it up, around middle. Aaron Finch drills it towards long on for a single.
Fuller now, quicker, around middle. Aaron Finch advances down the track and looks to go over cover, but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg. Single to end the over!
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg, slower one as well. David Warner works it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around middle. Aaron Finch pulls this towards the fielder at deep mid-wicket. The fielder there collects the ball on the bounce. Single taken!
A length ball, tailing back in around middle. Aaron Finch hangs back and pushes it towards cover.
Another shorter ball, outside off, much quicker this time. Aaron Finch looks to pull this but he misses.
Chamika Karunaratne begins with a back-of-a-length delivery, around middle, at around 128 clicks. David Warner pulls it to the fielder at deep square leg. Single taken!
Change of pace now! An off pace delivery, outside off, on a length. Aaron Finch blocks it out.
Fuller now, around middle. David Warner miscues his drives towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Wonderful shot once again! Dushmantha Chameera hits the deck hard once again, around middle. David Warner leans back, and upper cuts it over the keeper's head for a boundary. A perfect ramp shot!

FOUR! Oh, shot! That was not a bad delivery. A well-directed shorter ball, around middle and off. David Warner gets low, takes his eyes off the ball but still manages to pull it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Outside off, on a length. David Warner hangs back and cuts it towards the fielder at point.

Overthrow! A slower ball, on a length, around middle. Aaron Finch dabs it towards cover. David Warner leaves his crease, but he is sent back. There is a throw at the bowler's end but the ball misses the stumps and goes towards mid-wicket and take batters teal in a leg bye.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on. Went for 13 runs in his first over.
Fuller, around middle and off. David Warner defends it out.
Back of a length, around the off pole, a wrong'un again. Aaron Finch pushes it off the back foot towards cover for a single.
Swing and a miss this time! A googly, quicker through the air, full, outside off. Aaron Finch once again tries to sweep but he misses it this time.
SIX! KABOOM! A leg-break from Wanindu Hasaranga now, full again, outside off. Aaron Finch gets down on his knee and slog sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Tosses it up, fuller in length, outside off. Aaron Finch taps it towards point off the front foot.
Outside off, tad shorter. David Warner pushes it off the back foot towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Quicker, flatter, outside off. Aaron Finch presses forward and defends it out. Another good over for Australia 13 runs off it. Australia are 59 for 0 at the end of the Powerplay!

Excellent running! Another half-tracker, outside off this time. David Warner hangs back and punches it off the back foot through cover. They complete two runs and come back the third run as well. There is a throw at the keeper's end, but Aaron Finch dives in to make his ground.
A run out appeal! The replay shows Aaron Finch was in with a big dive. Not out it is.
Maheesh Theekshana comes round the wicket now serves a fuller ball, outside off. This time David Warner reverse-sweeps it over point for a brace.

FOUR! Poor delivery and punished! Another shorter ball, around middle and leg. David Warner gets low and sweeps it once again towards deep square leg for another boundary in the over. It's all too easy for Australia at the moment.
Quicker, shorter, around off, David Warner stays in his crease and blocks it out solidly.

FOUR! Australia are in a hurry here! A shorter ball, darting it on the pads, David Warner gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary. that brings up the 50 for Australia!

SIX! The last ball makes it even worse for Wanindu Hasaranga and Sri Lanka! This is a low full toss on off. Aaron Finch heaves it over cow corner for a biggie. 19 off the over and Australia are off to a superb start.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Wanindu Hasaranga under pressure now! Short again, on off. Finch stays on the back foot and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
This one spins back in, shorter and around off. Finch punches off the back foot to covers.
FOUR! Finch with the same intent as well! This is full and outside off. Finch drags it and hits it past mid-wicket and well wide of deep square leg for a boundary.
Length ball, on middle, it is flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! David Warner taking on Sri Lanka's best bowler right away! Tossed up, on middle. Warner skips down and lofts it over mid on for a boundary. Statement from the Aussie opener.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes to bowl now.

SIX! That will make Finch feel good. Beautiful shot this! A length ball, around off. Finch stays back and hits it through the line and all the way over long off for a biggie. A good end to the over for the Aussie.
Length ball, swinging into the batter. Warner looks to defend but inner edges it to short fine leg for a single.
Too full and on leg. Warner turns it behind square on the leg side for a brace now.
Length ball, outside off. Finch looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge to third man for a single.
On middle, tucked to deep square leg for a single.

IN THE AIR AND SAFE! A length ball, on off. David Warner swings across but fails to middle it. The ball skies and goes over mid off. Wanindu Hasaranga runs behind and tries to take over his shoulders but fails to get next to the ball. Two runs.
Dushmantha Chameera comes into the attack.

A beauty to end the over! This one lands on off and spins away. Finch is on the front foot as he tries to defend but the ball spins away and beats the outside edge. Another superb over from Maheesh Theekshana.

A direct-hit and Warner was a goner! Shorter and on middle. Warner tucks it to square leg and calls for a single. Charith Asalanka has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Warner was well short of his crease but luck was on his side.
Full ball, on leg. Warner pushes it gently to long on, in the gap and comes back for the second run.
Flatter ball, around middle. Warner flicks it off the back foot to mid-wicket. Three dots then.
Tossed up, a bit quicker and on middle. Warner is happy to keep this out as he blocks it out.
Full and on the pads. Warner tries to sweep it but misses.
Length and on middle, at 118 clicks. David tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and targeting the stumps. Warner defends it out solidly.
Full, width again but this time Warner hits it straight to the man at cover-point.
FOUR! Good shot! A length ball, outside off, width there. Warner cuts it hard and through backward point and the ball races away into the fence.
Full ball, hint of in-swing, outside off. Finch drives it through covers for a single.
Starts with a fuller ball, outside off. Warner leans and drives it through covers. The fielder gives a chase and cuts it out in a deep, saving a single. Three runs and Warner is away as well.
Nuwan Thushara will bowl from the other end.
A misfield and Australia are underway with it! Full and outside off. Finch drives it to backward point where Nuwan Thushara fumbles and allows a couple of runs. An eventful over comes to an end.
Tossed up, full and on off. Aaron drives it to point.
Length ball, outside off. Finch dabs it to backward point.

Not out! An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Aaron Finch takes the review as there is a big inside edge, confirms the UltraEdge as well. Sri Lanka almost thought they are off to a flier. Full, quicker and on middle. Finch looks to defend but the ball jags back in and it takes the inside edge before hitting the front pad.
Full ball, jagging back in around the pads. Finch misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. A half-hearted appeal follows...
Theekshana gets a bit of swing here! Too full and on off. Finch squeezes it out to covers.
